components.hint: N Mistakes {audience} Make With {category} (or N Reasons Your {status quo} Is Costing You)
Name the dream outcome they are missing
Each item: mistake → cost of mistake → mechanism that fixes it (product enters as the fix, not the opener)

reasons.heading_hint: Lead with the category's #1 objection framed as a mistake
Wrong heat type / missing red light / EMF fear — only verified facts
Assuming you need an electrician / huge footprint

notes: Do not bash named competitors with unverified claims.
Health outcomes need study citations from verified_claims.
Product appears as the fix inside each item, not a hard sell in the headline.

reason_fills: Treating recovery as a twice-a-month spa trip
Paying for memberships that sit unused
Buying heat without red light (or paying upsells) — verified framing only
Assuming home units need custom electrical
Comparing on price alone and skipping warranty/shipping
